title: Management security
credentials: Credentials are cleared after each request. Apply and recovery require fresh credentials.

exceptions.wbm_exposed: Acknowledge WBM exposure or unverified WBM security
exceptions.other_services_exposed: Acknowledge other management service exposure or unknown security
exceptions.unqualified_privileges: Acknowledge unqualified account privileges (required for key enrollment)

keyReview: Review: snapshot authorized keys, arm rollback, add a unique key, verify a new pinned key connection, then retain the recovery snapshot. Existing access remains enabled.
baselineReview: Review: snapshot access, arm reboot-safe rollback, add and verify a unique management key, restrict access, verify a new connection and the service baseline, then retain recovery.
confirm: I confirm the reviewed change or explicit recovery for this controller.
requestFailed: The management request did not complete. Refresh the saved status before retrying; interrupted transitions require recovery.
limitations: Automatic FW31 management hardening is not implemented. Missing operations are a restricted management account, root/password restrictions, WBM and service restrictions, and recovery that survives reboot. The FW31 vendor procedure for applying, restoring and persisting these changes is still needed. Key enrollment supports an existing non-root OpenSSH account or a detected Dropbear 2025.88 account. The new key disables forwarding and PTY allocation; account privileges and existing access remain enabled. Exceptions never count as hardened. Physical hardware verification is separate.
socketHint: Socket observations do not verify firewall reachability, WBM credentials or TLS.
rollbackFailed: Rollback could not be verified. The recovery journal and encrypted key are retained.
transitionFailed: The transition failed; check the saved recovery state.
recoveryDescription: Recovery restores saved management access. Enter fresh credentials for the original account. After interruption, recovery may remain busy until the five-minute operation lease expires. If SSH is unavailable, use the locally qualified USB-C/WBM recovery procedure.
loadError: Saved management status could not be loaded. Close and reopen this panel to retry.
description: Optional: check firmware and installation prerequisites. This does not change the controller.
inspectError: Could not inspect or clean up the controller. Check SSH access and try again.
codesysDisabled: Controller preparation verified CODESYS stopped and permanently disabled. This is a saved result, not a live controller status check.
observation: {{observation}}; uncertainty {{seconds}} seconds. A failed action does not prove the clock was unchanged.
clockCorrection: Installation will synchronize supported FW31 clocks to application UTC under your install approval, then verify the result before enrollment. Inspection never changes time.
savedSnapshot: Saved inspection snapshot; these values are not live controller status.
unsupportedFirmware: The controller has not reported an unambiguous CC100 FW31 release identity. A BSP version alone is insufficient.
preparationHint: Installation prepares supported Docker and persistent, limited digital I/O access. It must verify CODESYS is stopped and disabled before enabling I/O. An inspection report does not prove installation, management hardening or physical qualification is complete.
accessDenied: The runtime account cannot currently access the digital registers. Installation must establish and verify persistent access limited to the required input and output registers, or fail without enabling I/O.
permissionTool: The available tools cannot verify runtime-account permissions. A supported permission probe is needed before installation can proceed.
missingRegister: The expected digital registers are missing. Check the controller model and supported firmware; installation will not create substitute directories.
codesysActive: CODESYS is active. Destructive installation will stop and permanently disable it. Existing PLC applications and data may be lost; Attraccess will not preserve, back up, or restore them. Installation fails if CODESYS cannot be verified stopped and disabled before I/O.
codesysBoot: CODESYS is configured to start at boot. Destructive installation must disable that startup and verify CODESYS is stopped before I/O. A stopped process alone is insufficient. No separate PLC preservation or restoration approval is required.
containerConflict: Another container can write the digital outputs. Resolve exclusive ownership before installing this runtime.
packageActivation: This report could not establish a supported Docker package installation path. Retry installation only after the reported package or compatibility issue is resolved. An old inspection does not authorize activation by itself.
lifecycle: This report could not verify the Docker lifecycle dependencies. Installation must validate a supported activation path before changing Docker. Vendor activation can change startup, routing and firewall settings; preexisting settings are not restored by commissioning.
savedPreparation: Saved controller preparation: {{state}}. If runtime installation began, use Clean up failed installation first. Preparation cleanup reconciles its operation record; it does not restore previous workloads or host settings, re-enable CODESYS, or qualify physical I/O.
approveCleanup: I approve cleaning up this controller preparation. Preexisting workloads and host settings will not be restored.
